I am a final year Statistics undergraduate in the [Department of Statistics, University of Sri Jayewardenepura](https://science.sjp.ac.lk/sta/). I completed my primary and secondary education at [Maliyadeva Balika Vidyalaya](http://maliyadevabalika.lk/). Currently, I am conducting my final-year undergraduate research under the supervision of [Prof. Sarath Banneheka](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarath-banneheka-6403a660/).

I am passionate about **data analysis, statistical modeling, and programming in R**.\
My interests include Advanced statistical Inference, Probability and Distribution Theory, Statistical Quality Control, Time Series Analysis, Data Visualization, and real-world problem solving using data.

I enjoy transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support decision-making.
